given_when_then.given: An authorized actor initiates the creation of a new Customer Profile
given_when_then.when: The actor enters valid unique identifiers and contact details
given_when_then.then: The system creates a new Customer Profile with an active status and links it to the actor's session

given_when_then.given: An authorized actor initiates the creation of a new Customer Profile
given_when_then.when: The actor does not provide unique identifiers
given_when_then.then: The system prevents creation of the Customer Profile as a unique identifier is required before association with Order Requests

given_when_then.given: An authorized actor initiates the creation of a new Customer Profile
given_when_then.when: The actor provides contact details that have not been verified
given_when_then.then: The system creates the Customer Profile but the profile status remains inactive until verification is completed

given_when_then.given: An authorized actor attempts to modify an existing Customer Profile
given_when_then.when: The modification data contains invalid fields or formats
given_when_then.then: The system rejects the update and displays an error message indicating the validation failure

success_criteria: A new Customer Profile must be created with an active status only when unique identifiers and verified contact details are provided
Creation of a new Customer Profile is rejected if unique identifiers are missing
Profile status remains inactive if contact details are not verified
Modifications to Customer Profiles must be timestamped and attributed to the actor
Invalid data submissions for Customer Profile updates result in rejection with an error message
Contact details must be verified before the profile status is set to active
